AYES: Marty, Champion, Kent, Lopez Franzen

NAYS: Rosen, Ingebrightsen, Benson, Johnson, Kiffmeyer, Pratt

NAYS: Marty, Champion, Kent, Lopez Franzen
ABSENT: -

benefits for disabled or injured police officers requirement.

and Economic Growth Finance and Policy Committee.

Senator Pratt presented S.F. 1547 on behalf of bill author Senator Jon Jasinski

Senator Rarick moved the A-1 Amendment. THE MOTION PREVAILED and the A-1
AMENDMENT WAS ADOPTED.

1. Wendy Wulff, wife of injured bomb squad member Dan Wulff
2. Ethan Landy, General Counsel, Minnesota Department of Labor and Industry

Discussion.

Senator Rarick moved that S.F. 1547, as amended, be recommended to pass and re-
referred to the Jobs and Economic Growth Finance and Policy Committee.

AMENDMENT WAS ADOPTED.

Testimony From:

1. Doug Johnson

2. Dave Horsman, Vice President of Ballpark Operations for the Minnesota Twins

3. Scott McKown, Assistant Director, Construction Codes and Licensing Division,
Minnesota Department of Labor and Industry

Discussion.

Senator Rarick laid over S.F. 2698, as amended.

The meeting was adjourned at 10:00 a.m.

Senator Karin Housley, Senator Erin P. Murphy, Senator Carla J. Nelson, Senator Paul J. Utke, Senator Melissa H. Wiklund

S.F. 4357: Senator Abeler: Revisor of statutes instruction to renumber statutes related to the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance

Senator Abeler moved and presented the bill, SF4357, before the committee.

Committee Discussion.

Senator Abeler moved that S.F. 4357, be recommended to pass.

Senator Abeler moved and presented the bill, SF3249, before the committee.

Testifers:
Matthew Freeman, Minnesota Association of County Social Service Administrators
Angela Youngerberg, Blue Earth County

Molly Mcinerny, Senior Program Manager, Hope Street Shelter, Catholic Charities of Saint Paul, and Minneapolis

Finance and Policy Committee.

Senator Abeler moved and presented the bill, SF3347, before the committee.

Senator Abeler moved that the A-1 amendment be adopted to bill, SF3347.

The motion prevailed and the amendment was adopted on a voice vote.

Committee Discussion.

Senator Abeler moved that S.F. 3347, as amended, recommended to pass and re-referred to the Judiciary and Public Safety
Finance and Policy Committee.

HCBS update from Department of Human Services

Testifiers:
Elyse Bailey, Department of Human Services

Matt Burdick, Department of Human Services

Committee Discussion

S.F. 4189: Senator Nelson: Statewide pool; establishment and appropriation to asses certain out-of-home placements.

Testifers:

Angie Thies, Child Wellbeing Policy Analyst, Association of Minnesota Counties

Karen Sanness, Health and Human Services Director, Winona County

Committee Discussion.

Be laid over.

The meeting was adjourned at 2:48pm.

voice vote, the motion prevailed.

prevailed.

was requested. The results were as follows:

AYES: Rosen, Ingebrightsen, Benson, Johnson, Kiffmeyer, Pratt

NAYS: Marty, Kent
